question: Add a required field RetryConfig RetrySettings to the exporter.Settings struct. Every exporter factory in otel-contrib and Jaeger receives Settings when creating exporter instances. All callers constructing Settings literals will break.

struct_definition.description: The Settings struct is defined here with fields ID (component.ID), TelemetrySettings (component.TelemetrySettings), and BuildInfo (component.BuildInfo). Adding RetryConfig RetrySettings as a required field here triggers downstream breakage.

opentelemetry-collector.reason: Constructs an exporter.Settings{} literal for test use. Must be updated to include the new RetryConfig field.
ExporterBuilder constructs exporter.Settings literal when building exporter instances from configs and factories. Must populate RetryConfig.
Constructs exporter.Settings when building shared exporter instances in the pipeline graph. Must include RetryConfig.

opentelemetry-collector-contrib.impact: Each factory registers creation functions (CreateTracesFunc, CreateMetricsFunc, CreateLogsFunc) that receive exporter.Settings as a parameter. These functions can now access set.RetryConfig for retry configuration. The factory function signatures remain valid but can optionally use the new field.

jaeger.impact: The createTracesExporter function receives exporter.Settings. It can now access RetryConfig from the settings. Currently configures retry via exporterhelper options.

test_file_impact.description: Generated component test files across otel-contrib use exportertest.NewNopSettings() to construct Settings. Since NewNopSettings() is in core, updating it once propagates to all test consumers. However, any test that directly constructs exporter.Settings{} literal will also break.

answer.propagation_chain: exporter.Settings (struct definition) -> exportertest.NewNopSettings() (test helper) -> service/internal/builders/exporter.go (builder) -> service/internal/graph/exporter.go (pipeline graph) -> 47 contrib factory.go files + 1 Jaeger factory.go (receivers of Settings parameter)
